description: This file defines the interface for arbitrary precision big number (BIGNUM) operations used in cryptographic computations, including data structures, macros, and function prototypes for big number arithmetic, modular operations, and Montgomery multiplication.

classes.name: BIGNUM
classes.description: Represents an arbitrary precision integer with fields for data pointer, size, sign, and flags.

classes.name: BN_CTX
classes.description: Context structure for managing temporary BIGNUM variables during computations.

classes.name: BN_MONT_CTX
classes.description: Context for Montgomery multiplication operations, including modulus and precomputed values.

classes.name: BN_RECP_CTX
classes.description: Context for reciprocal division and modular reduction operations.

methods.name: BN_value_one
methods.description: Returns a BIGNUM representing the value one.

methods.name: BN_options
methods.description: Returns configuration options for BIGNUM operations.

methods.name: BN_bin2bn
methods.description: Converts a binary array to a BIGNUM.

methods.name: BN_bn2bin
methods.description: Converts a BIGNUM to a binary array.

methods.name: BN_mod_word
methods.description: Computes modulus of a BIGNUM with a word.

methods.name: BN_div_word
methods.description: Divides a BIGNUM by a word.

methods.name: BN_mul_word
methods.description: Multiplies a BIGNUM by a word.

methods.name: BN_add_word
methods.description: Adds a word to a BIGNUM.

methods.name: BN_sub_word
methods.description: Subtracts a word from a BIGNUM.

methods.name: BN_set_word
methods.description: Sets a BIGNUM to a specific word value.

methods.name: BN_get_word
methods.description: Gets the word value of a BIGNUM.

methods.name: BN_is_bit_set
methods.description: Checks if a specific bit is set in a BIGNUM.

methods.name: BN_lshift1
methods.description: Left shifts a BIGNUM by one.

methods.name: BN_exp
methods.description: Raises a BIGNUM to a power.

methods.name: BN_mod_exp_mont
methods.description: Performs modular exponentiation using Montgomery multiplication.
